We spend millions on strategy, workflows, and org charts—yet wonder why innovation stalls.

​The missing link? The leader's energy.
​As this powerful piece highlights, your team doesn't just listen to your instructions; their mirror neurons literally absorb your emotional state. If you walk in radiating panic, your team goes into survival mode, shutting down creative problem-solving.

​Great leadership isn't about being a thermometer that reflects market pressure. It's about being a thermostat that regulates it.

​Worth a read for anyone leading a team today. 👇
